task.title: P6-165: Stop MyRootNav from rendering and assembling the tree on desktop
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-165. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`MyRootNav` renders and `assemble()`s the tree on desktop too** (was `P6-021a`) — the `md:hidden` wrapper still mounts (`root.rs:163-188`), making three `assemble` calls per document load (rail, bottom-tab badge at `shell.rs:505`, root list at `all_cards.rs:132`) and re-rendering the hidden list on every debounced `?q=` keystroke on desktop `/my`.
